description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence. We are looking to fill this vital role quickly with a candidate who is passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare services.As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This leadership position offers a chance to shape the future of nursing services within a supportive environment. We offer a competitive salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: We offer a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience.
